site: Unnamed Seamount 07: Southwest of Salmon Bank
expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 15 was to explore a lumpy, isolated seamount feature (summit depth: ~2000 meters) southwest of Salmon Bank. Our goal was to examine how communities on this seamount compare with other, less isolated seamount communities across Papahānaumokuākea. We targeted a depth range between 2400 and 2200 meters in order to make comparisons against other seamount communities investigated during EX2503.
